preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The lengths of binary strings A and B must be equal and between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A) and all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both A and B must consist only of binary digits (0 and 1).

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of cyclic permutations of B that XOR with A to give 0.
